guild_join.title: Hello {guild}! 🎉
guild_join.description:
Thank you for inviting me to your server! 😊
Here are the commands to get started.
guild_join.setup: Allows an admin to setup a channel creator (or channel hub) which dynamically creates voice channels when users join them.
guild_join.help: Lists all the commands available to you and what they do.
guild_join.footer: Need more help? Reach out to support below!
general.donate.title: 💚 Thank you for using Robotnic!
general.donate.description: This bot as a **[FOSS](<https://wikipedia.org/wiki/Free_and_open-source_software>)** project with a **free** to use public instance, however this **costs money**. Current donations do not even cover hosting costs.
general.help.title: Command List
general.help.setup: Use this menu to create new `Creator Channel`s by clicking the green "Make new Creator" button or edit existing `Creator Channel`s using the dropdown list.
general.help.settings_controls: Allows changing the controls available to channel owners. Every button is togglable and you can choose between labeled buttons, icons or a dropdown menu as controls.
general.help.settings_logging: Allows for setting a log channel, if set, selected events will be logged in that channel. To customise the list, simply deselect the ones you would not like to include.
general.help.settings_profanity_filter: While still basic, this setting allows for disabling or only sending an alert if the profanity filter is triggered rather than blocking the action.
general.help.settings_dm_owner: Enable or disable DMing channel owners when they create a temporary channel. Defaults to on.
general.help.settings_language: Change the language Robotnic uses for messages in this server.
general.help.settings_placeholder_add: Add a custom placeholder for use in the naming scheme of a channel creator
general.help.settings_placeholder_list: List all custom placeholders for this server
general.help.settings_placeholder_remove: Remove a custom placeholder for this server
general.help.donate: Returns with information on how to support Robotnic's uptime.
general.help.footer: 📩 Need more help? Reach out to support below!

• **Private channels:** Lock/Hide and allow only selected members or roles.
